instances.claim: This tells me that the coins were given names, and that there was a body of collectors whose votes produced them.
instances.why: The definite phrases "The names" and "the collectors" both point back to things the draft never introduces: line 12 lists marks (verdigris, abrasion, a fingerprint), not names, and no line before 13 establishes that anything was named or that any collector community existed. "No algorithm assigned any of it" sets up a contrast with a human naming process that has been cut, so the second half of the line refers to a premise no longer in the piece.

instances.claim: This tells me that the set is organised by year and that it has gaps inside its range, of which 1943 is one.
instances.why: "The years it misses" is a partitive over a bounded collection of absent years, but the only edge the draft establishes is line 20's upper cutoff at 1982; nothing says the coins are dated year by year or that any year before 1982 is absent, so a missing 1943 is not licensed by anything in the draft.
